findings.evidence: `TauCeti/RingTheory/Semisimple/CentralCharacter.lean:115` already proves exactly that a central character equals any scalar having the same action on one nonzero vector; the new proofs repeat its `hsub`/`smul_eq_zero` argument at CentralCharacter.lean:139-142 and Eigenrow.lean:117-121.
findings.fix: Transport the relevant nonzero vector/action equation to the associated module and apply `TauCeti.centralCharacter_eq_of_ne_zero_of_smul_eq`; factor a representation-level wrapper first if needed, then use it in both proofs.
findings.issue: `centralCharacter_eq_of_equiv` (CentralCharacter.lean:123) and `centralCharacter_blockRepresentation` (Eigenrow.lean:104) both rederive scalar uniqueness via `sub_smul`, `smul_eq_zero`, and cancellation.

summary: Two proofs duplicate the existing central-character scalar-uniqueness API instead of reusing it.
